You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 7d6203af30b45bb1506e20935a270286c3e2393f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Wei Yongjun <yongjun_wei@trendmicro.com.cn>
Date: Sat, 7 Dec 2013 14:00:19 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] ahci: imx: fix the error handling in imx_ahci_probe()

Release alloced resources instead of direct return from
imx_ahci_probe() in the error handling case.

Fixes: 4a23d1793f8e ('ahci: imx: Add i.MX53 support')
Signed-off-by: Wei Yongjun <yongjun_wei@trendmicro.com.cn>
Signed-off-by: Tejun Heo <tj@kernel.org>
Acked-by: Marek Vasut <marex@denx.de>
---
 drivers/ata/ahci_imx.c | 3 ++-
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/drivers/ata/ahci_imx.c b/drivers/ata/ahci_imx.c
index 2daa28891b7f..dd4d6f74d7bd 100644
--- a/drivers/ata/ahci_imx.c
+++ b/drivers/ata/ahci_imx.c
@@ -331,7 +331,8 @@ static int imx_ahci_probe(struct platform_device *pdev)
 		if (IS_ERR(imxpriv->gpr)) {
 			dev_err(dev,
 				"failed to find fsl,imx6q-iomux-gpr regmap\n");
-			return PTR_ERR(imxpriv->gpr);
+			ret = PTR_ERR(imxpriv->gpr);
+			goto err_out;
 		}
 
 		/*
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by improper error handling in the `imx_ahci_probe()` function. When an error occurred while trying to find the `fsl,imx6q-iomux-gpr` regmap, the function was returning an error code directly without releasing any previously allocated resources. This could lead to resource leaks, as the allocated resources would not be freed if the function exited early due to an error. The patch corrects this by storing the error code and using a `goto` statement to a cleanup section that releases resources before returning the error.

You are a programming expert.
    You will be given the root cause of a bug and  the corresponding patch.
    You need to extract the code statements that lead to the bug from  the patch, based on the root cause.

    
    Provide a response strictly in the following format:
    Code statements:
    <text1>
    <text2>
    <text3>
    <text4>
    ...
    <textN>

Root cause:
The bug was caused by improper error handling in the `imx_ahci_probe()` function. When an error occurred while trying to find the `fsl,imx6q-iomux-gpr` regmap, the function was returning an error code directly without releasing any previously allocated resources. This could lead to resource leaks, as the allocated resources would not be freed if the function exited early due to an error. The patch corrects this by storing the error code and using a `goto` statement to a cleanup section that releases resources before returning the error.
